string-array.name: integrated_android_privacy_draft_paragraphs
string-array.item: This notice covers the Justnoise Android app (shop.justnoise.app), provided by Justnoise Media. Contact hello@justnoise.shop for privacy questions, access, correction or deletion requests. The iOS app, shop and Google Play have separate notices.

Accounts. We use Supabase to create and manage your account, email address, account ID, login provider, authentication tokens and profile information supplied by Google when you choose Google sign-in. Email/password and Google are available. Passwords are processed by our authentication provider, not saved as readable passwords in the app. Authentication tokens are protected using Android Keystore. An already restored account can use local Zap features offline.

Email. Supabase uses Resend to deliver confirmation and password-reset emails. Your email address and the authentication message are processed for delivery. Google processes its own sign-in flow if you choose that option.

App blocking. With your separate agreement and manual Android Accessibility permission, Justnoise detects the identity of the open app and window changes to block your selected apps during sessions. This also lets it check the currently open app before a scheduled start. It does not read screen content, passwords, typed text or notifications. These observations are temporary, stay on your phone and are not sent to us, Supabase or PostHog.

Local Zap data. Your mode names and selected app identifiers, schedules, session state and History are stored privately on this phone, in account-separated workspaces. History includes session IDs, start/end times, duration, selected-app count and interruption status, not an app-usage log. This version does not sync modes, schedules or History to the cloud. Onboarding, permission and recovery flags are also local.

NFC. Zap scans temporarily read NFC Text data. A keyed digest recognizes the paired Zap; raw tag text and hardware identifiers are not stored in History or sent to analytics. Pairing and installation-owned emergency unlock counts remain on this installation across sign-out and account deletion.

Optional analytics. Only after you separately opt in, the app sends session-start and session-end events to PostHog US Cloud, with a random process identifier. It sends no account ID, email, mode name, selected-app list, NFC content or Accessibility observations. PostHog receives the connection IP address and uses GeoIP to derive approximate location. This collection is not fully anonymous. There are no ads, session recordings or automatic screen tracking.

Analytics is off by default. You can turn it off in Account settings. The permission ends when the app process or account changes. Turning it off stops future events; it cannot recall events already delivered. Analytics is not needed to use Zap. Contact us for requests concerning previously received data; because the app does not send your account identity with events, we may need additional information to locate them.

Permissions and system surfaces. Accessibility is required for blocking. Exact-alarm access supports requested schedule times. Notifications are optional for session updates, including supported lock-screen surfaces; those may show the active mode name and timer. You can change these permissions in Android Settings. Refusing notifications does not prevent Zap sessions.

Retention and deletion. Local modes, schedules and History remain until you delete them or their account workspace, clear app storage or uninstall. Signing out retains that account\'s separate local workspace for a later sign-in. Account data is retained while the account exists. Supabase, Resend and PostHog process operational records under their retention controls; limited records may remain for security, delivery, backups or legal obligations. No fixed expiry is claimed for local History.

Delete your account in History → Settings → Account → Delete account. This removes the shared Justnoise server account and the Android account workspace; the same server account may also be used on iOS. Other accounts on this phone and installation-owned pairing, onboarding, permission and emergency state are not deleted by that action. Clear Android app storage or uninstall to remove installation-owned data. Account deletion does not remotely erase offline files on other devices.

You can also request account deletion at https://justnoise.shop/pages/android-account-deletion or by emailing hello@justnoise.shop from your account email. We verify ownership before deletion. Never send your password. Requests for access or correction can use the same contact.

Security and providers. App traffic to authentication, email and analytics providers uses HTTPS. Providers may process data outside your country, including PostHog in the United States. We use private app storage and Android Keystore; no system is guaranteed immune to loss or unauthorized access. App data is excluded from Android backup/transfer, without a guarantee about every manufacturer\'s restore behavior.

Justnoise does not sell your personal data or use it for advertising. Opening the optional Zap shop link uses your browser and the shop\'s separate policy. Updates to this notice will be shown here and on the public Android policy page.
